title: Reconstructing the Clebsch code and its golden orientation from its deep-hole syndrome locus
description: For a six-arc in PG(2,11), this preprint proves that the projective deep-hole syndrome locus lies on a conic exactly for the Clebsch hexagon, when it is the entire conic. Nearest-codeword data therefore reconstruct the non-GRS Clebsch code, parity-check geometry, polarity, and A₅ symmetry. Coset-leader ambiguity then recovers the golden orientation torsor, its support cubic, and the integral order Z[√5]. A uniform chord-defect bound reduces the analogous fixed-k existence problem to finitely many field orders.
